summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper: fetches Bun to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: @onereach/slack-helpers@1.0.3 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, sets it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js during npm install. math_init.js is a ~727KB '// @bun @bun-cjs' bundle using rotating string-array indirection and a large numeric index table decoded through a custom alphabet, with '.aws' substrings present among decoded strings. The payload is only reachable via the Bun runtime installed by the preinstall script and does not participate in the normal Node import graph. A Slack helper library has no legitimate need for a second language runtime, and the delivery pattern — pulling in an unrelated runtime specifically to execute a heavily obfuscated bundle unreadable to Node-oriented tooling — is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape rather than a build-tool integration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
